character.appearance: Strawberry blonde hair tied back, full beard. Ink-blue coat and Saint Christopher medal.
character.trait: Ambition persists across lives. Your will and soul are so closely bound that memories of this life would eventually return even after ordinary reincarnation.
character.condition: Breathing steady. Eyes sore, soles and hands cut, upper arm scratched, ribs tender. The left forefoot hurts under weight.

skills.name: Mana manipulation
skills.summary: Direct mana into a deliberate working.
skills.detail: First sensed beside the fallen pine. An involuntary shockwave briefly checked the undead. Water shaping and transmutation followed.

skills.name: Sharingan · one tomoe
skills.detail: Brief advance images guided counters and exposed openings. Both eyes bled. Deliberate activation remains untested.

skills.name: Water shaping
skills.detail: Rotating rings cut through scouts and forest for hundreds of metres. After resting, you joined a thread of creek water around the damaged ground beyond your sight.

skills.name: Material transmutation
skills.summary: Separate materials and form new objects.
skills.detail: You traced a circle in water, separated the debris and formed a complete outfit from a small part of it. Surplus material remains on the slope.

inventory.name: Saint Christopher necklace
inventory.description: A round Saint Christopher medal on a fine chain.

inventory.name: Ink-blue split coat
inventory.description: Ivory trim, three polished bone toggles and copper-coloured cuff lining. Split behind the knees for running.

inventory.name: Charcoal shirt
inventory.description: Open neck, worn beneath the coat.

inventory.name: Laced boots
inventory.description: One pair with soft woven uppers and dark resin-bound soles.

inventory.name: Blue pocket shirt
inventory.description: Sodden Earth shirt torn at the pocket, collar and sleeve.

inventory.name: Drawstring trousers
inventory.description: Sodden drawstring trousers torn at one knee.
inventory.source: Arrival and creek-bank change of clothes

story.title: Earth
story.text: You died in your sleep. The cause is unknown.

story.title: The threshold
story.text: People in a world losing its war prayed for a saviour. A presence recognised in your soul an affinity for that world and chose you.

story.title: The crossing
story.text: The presence carried your original body across and revived it. Your brain, memories and Earthly knowledge came with you.

story.title: The fallen pine
story.text: You woke barefoot in a remote forested valley wearing your Earth clothes and Saint Christopher necklace. Standing beside the fallen pine, you sensed a force within you.

story.title: Driven to the creek
story.text: Mindless undead closed around you. More cut off your escape through the timber. By the creek bend your feet were cut and your pocket torn. You fought unarmed in the shallows.

story.title: One tomoe
story.text: A shockwave briefly halted the scouts. You saw their strikes an instant ahead and caught a glimpse of red eyes, each marked with a single black tomoe, in the water.

story.title: The water rings
story.text: Rotating blades of creek water cut through the scouts and trees for hundreds of metres. With the immediate threat ended, you dropped to your knees laughing. The Sharingan faded.

story.title: A coat from the wreckage
story.text: After ten minutes of rest you traced a circle around the damaged forest and used its debris to make a coat, shirt, trousers and boots. Your Earth clothes lie beside you. A pale mineral line marks the circle across the slope.
